lines: “ATTENTION! Bihar Merit-Cum-Means Scholarship 2026–27 Online Applications close on 25th July 2026. Apply Now.”
Important Instructions for Student and Institution.
About Us: Building Bihar's Future Together

At the Bihar Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (BMMS Scholarship), we are a dedicated team of educators, policymakers, and visionaries committed to transforming lives through the power of education. BMMS Scholarship is an initiative designed to identify and support bright young minds from underprivileged backgrounds, ensuring they have the resources and opportunities to achieve their full potential.

Our program is tailored for the youth of Bihar, a state rich in culture, history, and talent. We believe that every student, irrespective of their economic condition, deserves access to quality education and a chance to build a successful future.
“BIHAR MERIT-CUM-MEANS SCHOLARSHIP 2026–26 ADMIT CARD WILL BE AVAILABLE FROM JANUARY 20TH, 2026.“
“Eligibility Alert: Students from Class 7TH to Class 12TH can now apply for the BMMS Scholarship 2024.“
“Special Notice: Applications are open for students studying in government or government-aided schools in Bihar.“
“Financial Aid Update: Scholarship covers tuition fees, books, and uniform expenses.“
“All aspiring scholars with economic challenges are encouraged to apply for BMMS.“
“Participating Schools: BMMS Scholarship is recognized by all government and government-aided schools in Bihar. “
